name: Enterprise Fund Committee Meeting Agenda 6-30-2020
agenda_text:
CITY OF EL MONTE

  MEETING AGENDA
  ENTERPRISE FUND COMMITTEE
  June 30, 2020 - 6:00 p.m.
  Online Teleconference Forum: ZOOM
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/87988958266
  Call In Number: (669)900-6833
  Meeting ID: 879 8895 8266

COVID-19 Remote Participation Protocols: Interested members of the public may view the
meeting by logging on to https://us02web.zoom.us/j/87988958266. Members of the public may
provide comment by submitting comments via e-mail to Priscilla Garcia at pgarcia@elmonteca.gov
by or before the 6:00PM start time for the meeting. Also, following the completion of the staff
presentation on Item 5(B), the chair will also give members of the public 5 additional minutes to
submit e-mail comments at the e-mail address identified above.

 1.  CALL TO ORDER

 2.  ROLL CALL

 3.  FLAG SALUTE

 4.  APPROVAL OF AGENDA

 5.  COMMITTEE BUSINESS AND DISCUSSION ITEMS

  Members of the public will be afforded an opportunity to comment and ask
  questions on each of the agenda items below but shall be limited to 2 minutes
  per person.

  A) Welcome
  B) Presentation and Review FY 20/21 Budget and Solicitation of
  Committee Comments and Recommendations to the City Council
  C) Selection of Chair and Vice Chair

  6.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATIONS

  7.  ADJOURN MEETING

  Agenda Posted: June 25, 2020
